Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body:
Eagle's Sight
[aus] This reacting vampire gets +1 intercept.

[AUS] This reacting vampire attempts to block the current action,
ignoring the normal prey, predator, or target restrictions for
blocking actions.

A question came up during a three-player game tonight, in which the
superior version would normally be worthless. I had an Eagle's Sight
in my hand, which I wanted to cycle, and for which situation I couldn't
use the inferior (the acting minion didn't have enough stealth).
Could I use it superior, despite not needing to? We ruled that I could,
as I just "attempted to block, ignoring the normal prey, predator, etc".
Was this a correct ruling?
Thanks in advance.

Kushiel
